name: Scaled dungeon creatures follow the viewer down to the finder entry's TargetLevelMin
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1 and DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1 with the default DestinyWeaver.Scaling.DungeonIds.
Inside a scaled five-player dungeon a creature stands at the viewer's own level, held inside the dungeon's band.
The band's floor is LFGDungeons.dbc TargetLevelMin, not the finder's MinLevel: Maraudon (map 349, entries 26,
272 and 273) has MinLevel 35 and TargetLevelMin 20, so a level-26 character sees a level-45 creature at 26
instead of 35, and a level-15 character sees it at the floor of 20. Black Riding Wolf 5194 is the fixture.

steps.label: A level-26 character sees the Maraudon creature at its own level
The level-26 character is sent level 26
A level-15 character sees the creature at Maraudon's TargetLevelMin of 20
Scaling off shows the authored level
